tasks.goal: Survey Jackson Square perimeter parcels bordering Decatur St and the Mississippi levee wall, capturing ground-truth imagery to grade parish record coverage claims.
tasks.terrain: Brick-paved flagstones of Jackson Square, uneven historic pavers, levee wall steps, park benches, fenced garden beds, tourist crowds
success: Complete perimeter loop of the square within 20 min
Capture >=12 geo-tagged images matching parish parcel boundaries
Zero falls on paver transitions; self-right within 5 s if slip
safety_stops: Stop if any human within 1.5 m of planned path
Halt near levee wall drop-off >0.4 m
tasks.human_in_loop: Person confirms which captured images are admissible as evidence-grade for the developer brief record.

tasks.goal: Map the Mississippi riverfront edge along Decatur Street to ground the New Orleans emerging-market edition basemap with a real corridor scan.
tasks.terrain: Riverfront concrete and asphalt mixed surface, streetcar rails on Decatur St, cobblestone transitions, puddles from river humidity
success: Produce occupancy map covering >=400 m of riverfront
Map error <0.5 m vs GPS track
Detect and mark streetcar rails as hazards in costmap
safety_stops: Stop when streetcar detected within 10 m
Cease operation in standing water >5 cm deep
tasks.human_in_loop: Person approves the final corridor map before it is published as an edition basemap layer.

tasks.goal: Walk the square interior checking signage and kiosk plaques against parcel records, verifying the seven-gate LOCATOR screen inputs for on-site data.
tasks.terrain: Grass and dirt paths inside the square, tree roots, statue pedestal base (Andrew Jackson), garden bed edging
success: Checklist state reports all 7 gates queried
safety_stops: E-stop on foot entanglement in roots/edging
tasks.human_in_loop: Person resolves any OCR ambiguities and marks unknowns explicitly per Evidence Layer rules.

tasks.goal: At the desk-side workbench, place graded evidence tags onto a sample board, physically demonstrating coverage grading with sample floor of 5.
tasks.terrain: Fixed indoor workbench, tag trays at fixed offsets, no ground hazards; cable run along bench rear
success: Place >=5 tags into correct grade slots, 100% accuracy
safety_stops: Joint velocity limit 50% when scanner zone breached
Stop if any hand enters workspace envelope
E-stop button on teach pendant honored <200 ms
tasks.human_in_loop: Person verifies the graded tag board matches the coverage rubric before logging.

tasks.goal: Lead a station-by-station curriculum tour at the square's walkway, narrating lessons from the 19-track Academy with gesture cues.
tasks.terrain: Flat flagstone walkways, low garden-bed borders to step over, variable lighting under oak canopy confusing vision
success: Complete >=3 lesson stations with speech-to-text accuracy >90%
Track one attendee for >=80% of tour
safety_stops: Sit down if balance controller reports instability
Pause speech if attendee closer than 0.5 m
tasks.human_in_loop: Person approves lesson pacing and corrects any curriculum content the docent misstates.

tasks.goal: Fly a low-altitude overview pass above the square's open center to generate a live contextual backdrop for the Master Dashboard overview.
tasks.terrain: Open-air plaza with oak canopy at ~15 m, flagpole cables, St. Louis Cathedral spires upwind, gusty river breeze off the levee
success: Hold 8 m altitude within ±0.3 m over plaza center
safety_stops: Avoid oak canopy by 3 m vertical buffer
Immediate land if any person enters 4 m bubble
tasks.human_in_loop: Person clears airspace each flight day and approves the sweep footage for dashboard use.
